exact_claim: Every independent concatenation of stopped standard Brownian pieces with common deterministic duration bound and divergent duration sums in both directions admits an almost surely finite random time S at which the two recentered halves are independent standard Brownian motions. S need not be a stopping time or junction; fixed-origin Brownianity is not required.
success_test: An exact finite random shift construction in full nonidentical-law scope, or a bounded-piece process for which every random origin fails. Fixed-origin bias and diffusive approximation alone are insufficient.
